lessons.title: Vocabulário
lessons.goal: Aprender o vocabulário da unidade: Society and ethics (equality, justice, discrimination, volunteer, charity, poverty, inequality, rights, community, responsibility, donate, ethical).

head: Palavra
Significado
Exemplo
rows: Gender equality is still a goal in many countries.
She volunteers at an animal shelter.
Workers have the right to a safe workplace.
A strong community helps people in need.
Parents have a responsibility to their children.
I donate blood twice a year.
Is it ethical to test products on animals?
Tolerance is important in a diverse society.

items: **raise** money / awareness; **do** voluntary work; **give to** charity
**take responsibility for**; **be responsible for**; **hold someone responsible**
**a matter of principle**, **a moral dilemma**, **a fair society**
"I do voluntary in a school." Use **I do voluntary work** ou **I volunteer at a school.**
"The poors need help." Use **the poor** (sem -s): **The poor need help.**
"I'm responsible of the project." O certo é **responsible for.**
"Society is more tolerant than before" ok. Mas "tolerant with" é erro: **tolerant of / toward** other cultures.

lessons.title: Wish, it's time, would rather e suppose
lessons.goal: Dominar a gramática da unidade: wish / if only, it's time, would rather e suppose com tempos do passado para falar de situações irreais.

head: Estrutura
Uso
Exemplo
rows: I wish I had more free time.
irritação com o comportamento de outros
I wish people would recycle more.
If only I could help more.
It's time we changed the law.
preferência sobre ação de outra pessoa
I'd rather you didn't smoke here.
I'd rather volunteer than donate money.
Suppose everyone stopped paying taxes. What then?

items: Depois de **wish** use **were** para todas as pessoas, na escrita cuidadosa: *I wish I were taller.*
**wish + would** é para algo que você quer que **outra pessoa** mude. Não se usa com **I**: *I wish I would* (errado).
**It's time** + passado soa estranho para brasileiros, mas o passado aqui é irreal. *It's time we left*, não *it's time we leave*.
"I wish I would have more time." O certo é **I wish I had more time.**
"It's time we go home." O certo é **It's time we went home** (ou *It's time to go home*).
"I'd rather you don't smoke." O certo é **I'd rather you didn't smoke.**
"Is time to change the law." Falta o sujeito: **It's time to change the law.**

lessons.title: Inglês prático, dar uma opinião sobre um tema social
lessons.goal: Usar o inglês prático da unidade: Dar uma opinião sobre um tema social.

head: Situação
Frases
rows: From my point of view... / As I see it... / I strongly believe that...
It could be argued that... / To some extent, yes.
I'm torn between... / There's no easy answer.
The main reason is that... / That's why I think...
I understand why some people feel that way.
I'm not sure I'd go that far.
In the end, it comes down to... / So, all in all, I think...

items: "In my point of view" é comum, mas o mais natural é **From my point of view** ou **In my opinion.**
"I'm agree that" não existe: **I agree that...**
"It's a polemic subject." **Polemic** é raro. Para tema controverso: **It's a controversial issue.**
